comment: School-wide parameters. penalty_weights tune the soft-cost landscape; hard_weight converts any hard-constraint violation into a dominating cost so the optimiser treats it as forbidden. No assumption is made about the total number of teachers: they are hired on demand under per-duration load caps. Facilities follow the school's guidance: ~16 classrooms per grade wing, plus shared labs and PE venues.

energy.comment: Cognitive-load model (low priority). hard_adjacency: two classes with difficulty >= threshold back-to-back in one segment. day_overload_factor: a day whose difficulty-weighted minutes exceed factor x the week average is a 'brutal day'.

facilities.comment: One wing per grade with ~16 classrooms each; labs and PE venues are shared across grades. PE must host a whole grade at once (grade-synchronised: 13 sections of <=20), hence 16 venues. Lab count follows the science load (~1050 lab sessions per cycle) with ~30% scheduling slack. No course in modules.xlsx needs a studio, so none are built.
